_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-08-04 · SkyUnit — each funding priority now carries its own PRICE FACTOR (the global 2× is retired); the split and the difficulty are separate dials now, and you can tune the factors right in the tab
_status: The $35M funding model is running, and it just got a new dial. Each priority now has a PRICE FACTOR — how much a CPL FTES is worth on that priority, as a multiple of the state rate. A higher factor pays more per FTES, so a college earns that pot with fewer FTES (a premium on the harder work). This splits what used to be one knob into two: the SHARE sets the dollars, the FACTOR sets how hard the FTES target is. Set all factors to 1.0 and it's exactly the old model. Live now: shares 50/30/20, factors P1 0.5 / P2 1.0 / P3 2.0 — the pool pays out 35.6% and the typical college earns 31% of its cap. Nothing about the pool ($23.24M) changed. Tune the factors in the tab (or the sanity-check tool linked there) and watch every number move. Next up is still the Budget reconciliation. The CCR/unified-courses items below are unchanged.

items.text: 🎚️ NEW: each priority now has a Price factor input (× the state rate per CPL FTES). Higher = pays more per FTES = the pot is earned with fewer FTES; set all three to 1.0 to get the old uniform model back. Live starting set is P1 0.5 / P2 1.0 / P3 2.0. Poke around — change a factor and every target, earned figure, and the statewide total recompute live. Same tool as the 🧮 calculation sanity-check linked at the top of the tab. If a different calibration is what you and Malone want, P2's factor has the most reach today (it's the biggest tranche).

⚖️ A decision worth making: 4 colleges (West Hills Coalinga, Santa Monica, Monterey, Moorpark) HAVE applied CPL credit but earn $0, because they have 1–4 students and the privacy rule hides the number. That's different from the colleges that posted nothing. Crediting a hidden cell has its own risk (we'd be paying on something we can't show), so it needs a call either way — the risk is that it stays an accident nobody chose.

📣 16 colleges have eligible CPL credit identified and have applied none of it — and applying is just a checkmark. That's an outreach list, not a performance verdict. Separately, 9 colleges have no MAP activity at all (Lake Tahoe, Imperial, LA Southwest, Rio Hondo, Marin, Cosumnes River, Folsom Lake, Siskiyous, Yuba) — an implementation gap that fixes itself as they come online. Barstow is healthy and earning.
